info.title: SDKWork Cloud Services API
info.description: Definition-only OpenAPI contract for SDKWork cloud service aggregation. Object storage follows the S3-compatible protocol model. IaaS compute APIs normalize provider capabilities for virtual machines, images, flavors, SSH keys, security groups, block volumes, Docker-compatible containers, and deployment rollouts across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, and Volcengine.

get.description: Lists configured cloud object storage provider plugins and their normalized S3-compatible capability coverage.
Retrieves normalized S3-compatible bucket, object, multipart, presign, credential, endpoint, and region metadata for a provider plugin.

Returns an S3-compatible endpoint, region, path-style flag, scoped bucket and optional temporary credentials so frontend code can reuse AWS S3-compatible SDKs such as @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Frontend SDK mode to request. Use temporaryCredentials for direct S3 SDK calls or presignedOnly for upload/download through presigned URLs only.

get.description: Lists buckets available to the selected S3-compatible provider account.

put.description: Creates a bucket using S3-compatible bucket creation semantics. Provider plugins map region and location constraints to provider-native fields.

head.description: Checks whether the selected S3-compatible bucket exists and is accessible.

delete.description: Deletes an empty bucket using S3-compatible bucket deletion semantics.

get.description: Retrieves the S3 bucket region or provider location constraint.
Retrieves S3-compatible bucket versioning state.
Retrieves S3-compatible bucket CORS rules.
Retrieves S3-compatible bucket lifecycle rules.
Retrieves S3-compatible bucket policy JSON.
Retrieves the S3-compatible bucket access control policy. Provider plugins normalize provider-native ACL grants into the S3 ACL model.

put.description: Updates the S3-compatible bucket access control policy. Supports canned ACLs and explicit grants when supported by the provider.

get.description: Retrieves S3-compatible bucket tag set.
Lists objects in a bucket using S3-compatible ListObjectsV2 semantics.

post.description: Deletes multiple object keys with S3-compatible DeleteObjects semantics, including versioned object identifiers and quiet mode.

put.description: Uploads an object using S3-compatible PutObject semantics. objectKey must be URL encoded when it contains slashes or reserved characters.

get.description: Downloads an object using S3-compatible GetObject semantics.

head.description: Reads object metadata using S3-compatible HeadObject semantics.

delete.description: Deletes an object using S3-compatible DeleteObject semantics.

post.description: Copies an object using S3-compatible CopyObject semantics. The x-amz-copy-source header or JSON source fields may be used by provider plugins.

get.description: Retrieves the S3-compatible object access control policy.

put.description: Updates the S3-compatible object access control policy. Supports canned ACLs and explicit grants when supported by the provider.

get.description: Retrieves S3-compatible object tag set.
Lists in-progress multipart uploads for a bucket using S3-compatible ListMultipartUploads semantics.

post.description: Initiates an S3-compatible multipart upload and returns the uploadId.

get.description: Lists uploaded parts for an S3-compatible multipart upload.

put.description: Uploads one part for an S3-compatible multipart upload.

post.description: Completes an S3-compatible multipart upload after all parts have been uploaded.
Aborts an S3-compatible multipart upload and releases uploaded part storage.
Creates a SigV4-compatible presigned URL for S3 object upload, download, head, delete, or multipart part upload.
Creates a browser-compatible S3 presigned POST policy with form fields and conditions.
Invokes a provider-native storage operation through a controlled envelope when a provider-specific S3-compatible feature is not yet available as a first-class standard operation.

get.description: Lists cloud IaaS provider plugins and normalized compute, container, and deployment capability coverage.
Retrieves normalized IaaS capabilities, credential modes, region and zone coverage, and deployment targets for a provider plugin.
Lists available provider regions for compute, container, and deployment workloads.
Lists availability zones in a provider region.
Lists normalized virtual machine instances across provider accounts, regions, and zones.

post.description: Creates a virtual machine instance using normalized image, flavor, SSH key, security group, network, and volume inputs.

get.description: Retrieves normalized details for a single virtual machine instance.

patch.description: Updates mutable metadata or requested size for a virtual machine instance.

delete.description: Deletes or terminates a virtual machine instance through the selected provider.

post.description: Starts, stops, reboots, resizes, rebuilds, snapshots, or resets credentials for a virtual machine instance.

get.description: Lists available VM images for a provider, region, architecture, and operating system.
Lists VM instance types, vCPU, memory, GPU, and family metadata.
Lists SSH public keys registered with the provider account.

post.description: Registers an SSH public key with the provider account.

get.description: Lists provider security groups and normalized ingress or egress rules.

post.description: Creates a provider security group with normalized rule definitions.

get.description: Lists provider block storage volumes used by compute workloads.

post.description: Creates a block storage volume with normalized size, type, encryption, and snapshot options.

get.description: Lists Docker-compatible containers managed through provider compute, container, or app-service runtimes.

post.description: Creates a Docker-compatible container workload with image, command, environment, ports, and resource requests.
Starts, stops, restarts, kills, pauses, unpauses, execs, or reads logs for a container workload.

get.description: Lists deployment application definitions that bind releases to compute, container, or provider app-service targets.

post.description: Creates an application abstraction for repeatable releases and rollouts across IaaS targets.

get.description: Retrieves a deployment application definition.

patch.description: Updates a deployment application name or labels.

delete.description: Deletes a deployment application after active rollouts are complete.

get.description: Lists releases created for a deployment application.

post.description: Creates a release with artifact, strategy, environment, and target selector for an application.
Promotes, rolls back, pauses, resumes, or cancels a deployment rollout.
Invokes a controlled provider-native IaaS operation when a capability is not yet promoted into the unified API.

delete.description: Deletes an SSH key from the provider account.

patch.description: Updates security group metadata and normalized ingress or egress rules.

delete.description: Deletes a provider security group when it is no longer attached to active resources.

patch.description: Updates metadata or resizes a block storage volume when supported by the provider.

delete.description: Deletes a block storage volume after it is detached.

post.description: Attaches a block volume to a compute instance.

delete.description: Detaches a block volume from a compute instance.

get.description: Retrieves a deployment release and its rollout link.
Lists deployment rollout progress across release targets.

ObjectKeyPath.description: URL-encoded S3 object key. Slashes and reserved characters must be percent encoded by clients when using this path form.

S3RangeHeader.name: Range
S3RangeHeader.description: HTTP byte range header for S3 GetObject.

S3ContentSha256Header.name: x-amz-content-sha256
S3ContentSha256Header.description: S3 SigV4 payload hash. Use UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD for compatible providers that allow unsigned streaming payloads.

S3ContentMd5Header.name: Content-MD5
S3ContentMd5Header.description: Base64-encoded MD5 checksum for S3-compatible object or part upload.

S3AclHeader.name: x-amz-acl
S3AclHeader.description: S3 canned ACL when supported by the provider.

S3StorageClassHeader.name: x-amz-storage-class
S3StorageClassHeader.description: S3 storage class when supported by the provider.

S3CopySourceHeader.name: x-amz-copy-source
S3CopySourceHeader.description: URL-encoded S3 copy source in /source-bucket/source-key form.

S3ChecksumAlgorithmHeader.name: x-amz-checksum-algorithm
S3ChecksumAlgorithmHeader.description: S3 checksum algorithm for object and multipart part upload integrity validation.

S3ServerSideEncryptionAwsKmsKeyIdHeader.name: x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id
S3ServerSideEncryptionAwsKmsKeyIdHeader.description: S3 KMS key id for server-side encryption with KMS-compatible providers.

S3TaggingHeader.name: x-amz-tagging
S3TaggingHeader.description: URL query encoded S3 tag set for PutObject or CreateMultipartUpload.
